description: Contract of K-LCR parameter sets and results, version 1. PARAMETERS_AND_RESULTS.md explains it; tools/check_parameters.py is its reference validator.

decimal.note: Factors and limits are decimal fractions written as JSON strings: 0.25 means one quarter, never a percentage.

statuses.illustrative: Values chosen for synthetic fixtures only. A result computed with them is labelled illustrative and is never a regulatory figure.
statuses.sourced: Every value was read in its source and verified against its locator on the date recorded.

fields.parameter_set: Identifier of the set; it names the source edition and never changes once used.
fields.source_register_version: Version of SOURCES.md the set cites.
fields.categories_version: Version of categories.json the set covers.
fields.verified_on: Date of the verification, YYYY-MM-DD; required when status is sourced, absent otherwise.
fields.factors: One entry per in-scope category of the profile except exclusion categories: category, kind, value, source, locator; Basel discretionary categories add discretion_choice.
fields.limits: One entry per limit of the profile: id, value, source, locator.

statuses.calculated: The run passed the input contract and the calculation completed.
statuses.rejected: The input contract reported findings; no figure is given.
statuses.failed: The calculation could not complete; no figure is given.

fields.illustrative: true when the parameter set is illustrative.
fields.lineage: run_fingerprint, input_contract_version, parameter_set, parameter_set_sha256, categories_version, source_register_version and code_commit.
fields.figures: Only when calculated: liquidity_buffer, outflows, inflows, inflows_after_cap, net_outflows and lcr, each a decimal string in the reporting currency except lcr, a decimal fraction.
fields.components: Only when calculated: one object per category with exactly category, amount, factor (at most 1) and weighted, each a decimal string except category, so that every figure reconciles with the input totals.
fields.diagnostics: Every diagnostic, with code, severity, message and the records or limits it refers to.

CALC-INPUT-REJECTED.meaning: The input contract reported findings; their codes are listed.

CALC-ILLUSTRATIVE.meaning: The parameter set is illustrative: the result is not a regulatory figure.

CALC-PARAMETER-SET-INVALID.meaning: The parameter set does not pass its contract.

CALC-PARAMETER-SET-PROFILE.meaning: The parameter set belongs to another profile or source edition than the run.

CALC-ASSET-EXCLUDED.meaning: A holding with requirements_met N is left out of the buffer.

CALC-OUTSIDE-HORIZON.meaning: An item maturing after the 30-day horizon is left out.

CALC-COMPOSITION-LIMIT.meaning: A composition limit of the buffer binds.

CALC-ZERO-NET-OUTFLOWS.meaning: Net outflows are zero, so the ratio is undefined; no ratio is given.

CALC-BELOW-MINIMUM.meaning: The ratio is below the profile's minimum requirement.

CALC-INTERNAL.meaning: An unexpected condition stopped the calculation; earlier outputs are withdrawn.
